item.title: IHE star wins Freedom of the City
item.description: The Institute of Highways Engineers (IHE) would like to congratulate one of its stars, Ola Faleti, who has been awarded the Freedom of the City of London.

item.title: Huyton Asphalt and HA Civils launch new apprenticeship course
item.description: Huyton Asphalt and HA Civils have collaborated to launch a new apprenticeship pathway for highway maintenance operatives at Hugh Baird College.

item.title: Ecofill appoints new chief financial officer
item.description: Mark Watford has been appointed as chief financial officer (CFO) of Ecofill Group, a Leeds-based company that turns on-site clay and subsoil into aggregate replacement products.

item.title: BCIS appoints new talent lead
item.description: The Building Cost Information Service (BCIS) has welcomed Natalie Cross as its new talent lead as the business announces plans to expand in its 65th anniversary year.

item.title: Costain wins £100m M5 gigafactory junction contract
item.description: Costain has been appointed by National Highways to design and build a new junction on the M5 motorway, with the contract valued at roughly £100m over five years.

item.title: Yorkshire Highways Alliance tenders £45m surface treatment framework
item.description: A new £45m specialist surface treatment framework has been tendered by the Council of the Borough of Kirklees on behalf of the Yorkshire Highways Alliance.

item.title: Comment: To have transparency, we must first have clarity
item.description: Jonathan Munslow, chair of the NHT Network - the sector's largest public satisfaction survey - responds to the Government's recent local highways authority road maintenance ratings; arguing in favour of transparency but also the need for trust in the system that provides it.

item.title: New guidance for floating bus stops published
item.description: The Department for Transport (DfT) and Active Travel England (ATE) have jointly published new statutory guidance for the design and provision of floating bus stops after ministers issued a pause on the controversial designs last year.

item.title: Comment: Telematics and the future of fleet management
item.description: Kathryn Vassilissin, sales manager for vendor finance Siemens Financial Services (SFS) discusses the telematics revolution in fleet management.

item.title: Kent County Council trials new active travel app
item.description: Kent County Council (KCC) has launched a new active travel app designed to help people in Gravesend get more walking, wheeling and cycling into their daily lives.
